swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP63203WU-7 (TSOT-23-6) vs TPS563201DDCR (SOT-23-6) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN). Soldering TPS563201DDCR onto a AP63203WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL FEEDBACK LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; adding or removing the external R1/R2 feedback divider and feedforward capacitor requires a PCB layout change.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 47% (AP63203WU-7: 1100 kHz p.5 vs TPS563201DDCR: 580 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP63203WU-7: 3.9 µH p.13 vs TPS563201DDCR: 2.2 µH p.15); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP63203WU-7: 32 V p.4 vs TPS563201DDCR: 17 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP63203WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS563201DDCR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS563201DDCR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (19 V, p.4) than AP63203WU-7 (35 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 19 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TPS563201DDCR requires Vin,min >= 4.5 V (p.4) vs 3.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP63203WU-7: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C TA, TJ max 125°C) vs TPS563201DDCR: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ)); AP63203WU-7 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS563201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN); fixed vs adjustable output feedback footprint mismatch (R1/R2 divider). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 1100 kHz (p.5) vs 580 kHz (p.6) (1.9x ratio), typical inductor 3.9 µH (p.13) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), output mode fixed vs adjustable, and package θJA 89 vs 92.6 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP63203WU-7 "CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TPS54302DDCR, TPS563201DDCR & AP62200WU-7!" (p.1) and TPS563201DDCR "17 V Max Input (19 V Abs Max) Fails on 24 V Buses Built for Pin-Identical TPS54302DDCR" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose AP63203WU-7 when bus voltage exceeds 17 V (rated to 32 V) or light-load battery standby needs 22 µA Iq; choose TPS563201DDCR when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
